title: Instant Student Activation & Carrier IPv4 Resilience (v0.4.22)
message: Resolved student activation lockup with instant fast-path Firestore claiming, prioritized IPv4 routing to bypass carrier VoWiFi IPv6 blackholes, and introduced a 15-second fail-safe watchdog on all loading states.
changelog:
• Instant Student Activation: Prioritized Firestore pending_students lookup before touching Firebase Auth, cutting claim latency from minutes to instant.
• Carrier VoWiFi IPv6 Resilience: Enforced preferIPv4Stack in application runtime to eliminate connection freezes caused by broken cellular VoWiFi IPv6 tunnels.
• 15-Second Fail-Safe Watchdog: Protected global loading spinners with an automatic 15-second timeout watchdog so UI never hangs indefinitely.
• Dialog Crash Protection: Safeguarded custom and notice dialogs against Activity lifecycle BadTokenException crashes.
• Debug App Check: Dynamically enabled DebugAppCheckProviderFactory for development and debug testing.
